core_meaning.primary_meaning: Meraj is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Ascension, night journey”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Meraj corresponds to the Arabic form معراج (Arabic root ع ر ج (ʿ-r-j); مِعْرَاج (Miʿrāj)). Its core sense is ascension, night journey. Meraj is Arabic مِعْرَاج (Miʿrāj) 'ascension, night journey', from the root ع ر ج (ʿ-r-j); it is the Qur'anic term for the Prophet's night journey. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave ميراج (a different form); the correct form is مِعْرَاج. The source gloss 'Journey to the Heights' is broadly consistent. Same name as miraj.
